frequently asked questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Answers about the studio, equipment, bookings and photoshoots.

When can I use the studio?

By appointment: Monday to Friday 09:00–22:00 and weekends 10:00–22:00.

Can first-time creatives book?

Yes. We will show you the basics of using the studio equipment on site.

How do I book?

Choose a suitable time on the booking page, or email us with your idea.

Package prices, cancellation rules and contact details must be finalized after the source audit.
